title: A Solid Three
text:
A Solid Three. So many issues...

The wand is too short. I'm 5'2" and If it's short for me, it's too short
The attachments don't have a home on the vacuum. They come in a little bag and you have to keep track of where you put them
The attachments are weak and lame. Not very robust at all.
The hose doesn't stay attached to the wand very well. This has pretty good suction so sometimes the floor brush gets stuck and the hose just comes off the wand.
The wheels get caught on things. Something about the dynamic or the placement of the wheels made this hard to drag around objects. It kept getting caught.
Emptying is a mess. As soon as you pop the bottom of the canister there is dust everywhere.

The good..
Has great suction. In fact so much that it was hard to use on my rubber matted studio floor. Kept wanting to pull up the floor even on low.
